name: jsdom
reason: DOM/browser emulation whose XML documents are built from saxes events (saxes ^6.0.0 resolves to 6.0.0, the selected saxes path), so it shares the saxes family; HTML goes through parse5. Its documented new JSDOM(text, {contentType: 'application/xml'}) path builds a namespace-aware DOM from strictly decoded local text. Both valid namespace-aware controls match the expat oracle, with pinned npm integrity and transitive lock, V8 coverage of the jsdom package, its XML parser file and underlying saxes counted separately, and input-dependent AFL++ feedback from construction only. jsdom copies DOCTYPE entity declarations into saxes and forces XML 1.0 rules.

name: htmlparser2
reason: Pinned xmlMode Parser.write/end API parses both valid XML controls into raw qualified-name events matching non-namespace Expat oracle; own tokenizer and entities source covered with stable parser-scoped AFL differential. It neither resolves namespace URIs nor enforces XML well-formedness, and package downloads mostly measure HTML use. Verified: projects/xml/javascript/htmlparser2.

name: fast-xml-parser
reason: Own string scanner (OrderedObjParser) and validator behind XMLParser.parse(Buffer, true); no namespace URI resolution, so the adapter resolves prefixes from in-scope xmlns attributes. Both valid namespace-aware controls match the expat oracle, with pinned npm integrity, V8 package-source coverage, and input-dependent AFL++ feedback verified.

name: @xmldom/xmldom
reason: Promoted to verified: own XMLReader tokenizer and DOM builder; strict UTF-8 local-text adapter matches the expat oracle on both controls.

name: xml2js
reason: Object-tree builder over sax events (sax >=0.6.0 resolves to 1.6.1, the selected sax path), so it shares the sax family; its documented Parser({xmlns: true, explicitChildren: true, preserveChildrenOrder: true, charsAsChildren: true}) tree keeps sax-resolved URIs and ordered children. Both valid namespace-aware controls match the expat oracle, with pinned npm integrity, V8 xml2js and underlying sax source coverage, and input-dependent AFL++ feedback verified. Comments and processing instructions are dropped, so text split only by them merges.

name: xmlbuilder2
reason: Documented create(xmlString) genuinely parses XML through xmlbuilder2 XMLReader and @oozcitak/dom XMLStringLexer, but the pinned 4.0.3/2.0.2 native DOM fails the primary namespace-aware control: c:catalog is assigned the default urn:parsarium:item URI instead of urn:parsarium:catalog, and c:lang on the first item has null URI instead of urn:parsarium:catalog. The second valid control parses, but the first fails the XML cell requirement for parser-observed expanded names. A separate adapter can reconstruct names from retained QNames/xmlns declarations, but that would mask the native result, so the path is not selected or ranked. No malformed inputs or fuzz campaign were run.

name: xml-js
reason: Documented xml2js(string) API builds an ordered tree over sax.parser(true) with a hardcoded pure-JavaScript path. Both valid XML controls match the namespace-aware Expat oracle after the adapter expands xmlns prefixes. Pinned source/integrity, Docker V8 coverage of xml-js tree-builder and sax tokenizer separately, and stable parser-only input-dependent AFL++ feedback are recorded. It shares the selected sax 1.6.1 parser family.

name: xmldoc
reason: Pinned XmlDocument(text) builds a raw qualified-name tree over sax 1.6.1; both valid controls match the projected non-namespace Expat oracle, with package and underlying sax coverage and stable AFL differential. Namespace URIs are not resolved. Verified: projects/xml/javascript/xmldoc.

name: @xml-tools/parser
reason: Pinned 1.0.12 parse(text) reads strictly decoded local bytes and returns a hierarchical raw-QName XML CST on both valid controls with zero lex/parse errors. Docker covered 351 own grammar/lexer source lines and 5,225 Chevrotain engine lines; three-repeat AFL++ parser callback hit-count feedback is stable and differs by 22 features/tuples. It does not resolve namespace URIs or decode entity references in the CST; the adapter does not repair those fields. Selected as a limited raw-QName XML CST parser; neither namespace URI resolution nor entity-text decoding is claimed.
